items.before: Before, the INS home's only way to start was a 'Start a new notification' button, shown only when the organisation had no notifications, and it opened the live animals notification list. Now 'Create new' opens a new page, 'What are you importing?', under the caption 'About the consignment', with five options and none chosen: Live animals; Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos); Plants for planting; Potatoes (seed and ware); Wood products. It has a single Continue button, a Back link to the INS home and no Draft tag or reference, and Dashboard stays highlighted in the navigation. Continuing with nothing chosen shows 'Select what you are importing'. No notification exists until an option is chosen and Continue pressed. Live animals then opens a new live animals draft on Origin of the import, with its Draft tag and GBN-AG reference. A plants option opens a new plants draft (see the next card but one). Germinal products goes to where the germinal products service will start, which is not built yet. Leaving with Back creates nothing. Starting from the live animals or plants notification list still skips the question.
items.after:
Before, the INS home had only one way to start: a 'Start a new notification' button.

It was shown only when the organisation had no notifications. It opened the live animals notification list.

Now 'Create new' opens a new page, 'What are you importing?'. Its caption is 'About the consignment'.

It has five options, with none chosen:

- Live animals
- Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos)
- Plants for planting
- Potatoes (seed and ware)
- Wood products

- a single Continue button
- a Back link to the INS home
- no Draft tag or reference

Dashboard stays highlighted in the navigation.

Leaving with Back creates nothing.

Starting from the live animals or plants notification list still skips the question.

items.before: Before, the INS home showed 'Start a new notification' only to an organisation with no notifications. With notifications, or after a search, there was no way to start from the home.
